title: Finite-time blow-up for the mass-critical half-wave equation with negative energy
summary: We study the one-dimensional focusing mass-critical half-wave equation \[ i\partial_tu=|D|u-|u|^2u. \] For even initial data with negative energy and mass slightly above the ground-state mass, we prove finite-time blow-up and obtain the upper bound \[ \|u(t)\|_{\dot H^{1/2}} \lesssim \frac{|\log(T-t)|^{1/4}}{\sqrt{T-t}} \qquad\text{as }t\uparrow T. \] This is the first finite-time blow-up result for negative-energy solutions to the mass-critical half-wave equation in the near-ground-state regime. The proof uses the modulation analysis developed by Merle--Raphaël…
